cases.title: Valid login is accepted
cases.actual: Signed in; dashboard rendered with heading 'Security Overview'

cases.title: Invalid password is rejected
cases.expected: HTTP 401, generic error, stays on login
cases.actual: HTTP 401; message 'Invalid email address or password.'; stayed on /login

cases.title: Empty credentials are validated
cases.expected: Inline field errors, no request sent
cases.actual: 2 inline validation messages shown; no request sent

cases.title: Dashboard loads live statistics
cases.expected: KPI tiles and charts populated from API
cases.actual: 4 KPI tiles present; 25 chart canvases rendered from API data

cases.title: Brute-force event is classified
cases.expected: Brute Force Attempt, CRITICAL, with reasons
cases.actual: Classified 'Brute Force Attempt', severity CRITICAL, reasons and action displayed

cases.title: Invalid IP address is rejected
cases.actual: Rejected with field-level error: 'source_ip must be a valid IPv4/IPv6 address (received '999.999.1.1').'

cases.title: Alerts filter by severity
cases.actual: Filter applied server-side; 15 rows before, 15 CRITICAL rows after

cases.title: Incident shows legal transitions only
cases.actual: Lifecycle tracker shown; only permitted transitions offered; history rendered

cases.title: CSV log upload is analysed
cases.actual: 120-row CSV parsed, validated, analysed and summarised by severity

cases.title: Report generation
cases.actual: Report generated with an RPT- code and data-derived recommendations
